eld.text: Edgewall, a village on Eldraine whose sewers were overrun by rats, shows up on this set's cards as an inn and keep at the edge of the wilds.
Lord Skitter promised Totentanz wicked powers in exchange for luring the townsfolk into the sewers, and gifted him a magic pipe when he agreed to join him.
Totentanz led Edgewall's citizens into the undercity and rats swarmed the village, but the townsfolk stole the pipe and turned its magic on Skitter and Totentanz, who were devoured by the rats.
After Skitter's rats failed to invade Edgewall, they presumably devoured him and returned to normal.
